task: Implement runtime support for documentation and decision-doc audit using ordinary automatic review escalation with explicit degraded 3x1 fallback.
outcome: User runs a zero-finding decision-doc story and DONE no longer says "changed decision docs require host_verdict quorum"; a threshold-triggered story says "Review escalation: required" and degraded fallback says "assuranceLevel=degraded-single-host".
facts: B-b663 updated the execution plan: direct decision-doc changes are no longer the target always-on 3x2 trigger.
Current machine.canFinish and DONE guard failure reason unconditionally consume evaluateDecisionDocQuorum, so direct decision-doc diffs still block DONE today.
Existing host verdict storage already captures hostId, sessionId, keyId, materialDigest, validationDigest, and promptDigest in verdict files, but process-events currently persist only a subset.
Process-fact contract rules require gate-consumed facts to be registered in registry, levels, command policy, CLI schema, and verifier script.
The runtime must not claim Authority receipt completion from local host verdicts or degraded single-host review.
constraints: Do not run omx or read/write/use .omx.
Do not directly edit docs/story or tests/fixtures.
Keep operator-facing text in English for open-source readiness.
Do not silently downgrade 3x2 to 3x1; degraded fallback needs explicit eligibility, reason, evidence or approval, and lower-assurance output.
Keep implementation scoped to local Lattice runtime; no remote push or Authority Server implementation.
